title: Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass Carolina | Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with this wall mount retractable hook/garment rod that pulls out for 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in when not needed.

Highlights:
- Retractable rod provides 2-1/2 inches of hanging space and stows away neatly
- Solid brass construction for enduring bathroom use
- Holds up to 15 lb for coats, robes, and towels
- Wall mount design helps keep items within reach while saving floor space
- Part of the Carolina collection for coordinated bathroom hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Material: brass
- Mounting: wall mount; fits standard interior walls
- Installation requires drilling one 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Hardware included: toggle bolts (6/32 toggles)
- Dimensions: 3.75-inch W x 1.75-inch H x 1.75-inch L; 1-inch projection
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Assembly required: no
- Finish options available across multiple designer finishes, including statement colors

_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
